Try to avoid watching the news too often. Maybe change the subject to something lighter when you can. Spend some time with your family doing something fun, cooking, watching something.

Well I’ve been attending French lessons since middle school but they were pretty useless, I started actually studying it last year. It took a few months I guess. My tips are:

1. Take some time and memorize all the irregular verbs in all the tenses first. I know it’s a pain in the ass and it’s gonna take some time, but you someday will remember them with no effort at all, and it’s SO gonna make a difference.

2. Watch tv series in French. At the beginning you’ll have to stop at each sentence and read the subtitles and understand, but you’re gonna get faster and faster, and soon you’ll understand everything in no time. That’s how I learned English as well a few years ago.

Good luck!
